description: Every WARN Act layoff and closure notice one employer has filed, across all covered states, with a per-state and per-year breakdown. Answers "has Tesla filed layoff notices", "how many workers has Amazon laid off by WARN filing", "which sites did this company close". Use to trace one employer's layoff history rather than browsing a date range.
